title: Cold shower and old TV
text:
Today was another late-August day. The heat and humidity are almost intolerable. I've been sweating a lot and mostly just feeling the warmth everywhere, in my hair, ugh.

For lunch I had a plate of oven fries and a soda, I think. For dinner I'll have something like half of the pizza that's in the fridge.

I watched strange horror and/or surreal TV shows from the '80s and '90s. It was cozy-feeling, and although I was a young child in the '90s and don't remember any of the old commercials—it was just too long ago for me to connect them to any specific nostalgia—it still felt nostalgic.

I took a cold shower and messed around on my website a bit. I don't know what I'll do later. Maybe hang out with Z for a bit and watch something. It'll be hot again tomorrow, so I'll probably stay up again or get horrible sleep. I just don't sleep well in the heat.

I also watched Children of the Corn. I'm really looking forward to when the weather finally changes for fall...

title: New computer
text:
I finally got a new computer. My last one was an Alienware that I bought from my brother's friend a few years ago. I love my Samsung 34-inch monitor. I kind of prefer it to having two screens, I guess, but I may add more displays soon. I got my first gaming computer around 2020.

Anyway, I need to get a new laptop next. My brother reminded me this morning that I really need a new one because mine is all busted. Right now, I have a Lenovo IdeaPad, and, to be honest, it wasn't bad for $300. I kind of want a MacBook or maybe even an iPad, but I need to check and see what's out there.

title: Late August
text: Yesterday was a strange but pleasant late-August day. It was hot and muggy, and I ate nice ice cream bars all day. I watched a strange movie, Misery (1990), from the Internet Archive, then messed around in Blender, practicing rigging. I don't know; it was just so nice. I guess it was the ice cream that made the day feel dreamy.
